inspected_pairs.observation: The thin angular wrist detail remains separated and recognizable after a modest coherent shift; surrounding silhouettes and gaps remain open without bridge, fusion, spike, slab, flattening, inversion, or neighbor deformation.
Layered angular constituents retain edge character, credible thickness, and open negative-space channels without a falloff kink or propagated neighboring-component damage.

The compact faceted medial profile, fine pointed forms, seams, multi-plane surface, and foreground/background order remain credible without a novel spike, closure, fusion, slab, flattening, or inversion.

The wearer-facing plate, long channel, and small lower-edge constituents retain their outline, planar character, separation, and depth order without new bulge, pinch, slab, bridge, or neighbor alteration.

The clearest delta is a coherent clearance-direction shift of the component-52 cluster; internal faceting and neighboring elements remain recognizable, while the dominant negative space enlarges rather than closes.
At complete wrist scale the local shift does not read as broken registration; circumference, opening shape, layered rim, loops, and constituent arrangement remain stable.
Full dorsal silhouette, wrist opening, outer loop, rails, separated constituents, and intentional gaps remain aligned with no visible 35 mm falloff boundary.

The wearer-facing full-arm outline, wrist aperture, rail and circular details, and major separations remain stable without transition line, closure, bridge, spike, slab, flattening, inversion, or neighbor change.
Medial silhouettes, inter-constituent openings, long rails, wrist cluster, panels, and upper-arm surfaces remain registered without falloff kink or neighbor displacement.
Lateral contours, wrist assembly, long rails, and intentional gaps remain visually equivalent without unacceptable registration drift or falloff distortion.

Oblique wrist depth, circular details, layered pieces, open spaces, and long constituent spans retain their ordering without crease, silhouette change, closure, fusion, flattening, inversion, or neighbor drift.
Complementary oblique context preserves wrist depth, upper/lower separation, long negative spaces, and outer silhouette without visible falloff transition or neighboring alteration.
The distant upper-arm central plate, perimeter layers, circular side detail, and open loops retain matching silhouette, proportion, and depth order; no unintended regional propagation is visible.

uncertainty: Source and current use different display colors, reducing sensitivity to extremely subtle shading-only differences.
The local wrist-axial shift is noticeable in the deliberately tight crop, but complete axial, orthogonal, oblique, and distant views show it remains compositionally credible.
The repair leaves 326 global cutter penetrations, 338 reserved-margin violations, and 769 triangle overlaps, so it cannot support fitted-surface promotion.
